newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds steady in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds steady in late trading.

text.p: LME copper prices were little changed in late trading on Tuesday after staging a modest recovery from Monday's sharp fund sell-off earlier in the day.
At 1800 GMT flagship three months copper was indicated at $2,291/95 per tonne after ending the afternoon kerb at $2,292, an increase of $14.
Cash/threes backwardation remained flared at $43/$48, which was helping to underpin prices, analysts said.
Aluminium was similarly static in late trading at $1,582/85, versus a virtually unchanged $1,582.50.
Aluminium prices had consolidated in a narrow range during the day after tumbling sharply with the rest of the base metals on Monday.
